narrative: 社会几何关系可以一眼被看见。大人们在近处的房间里签下一个男孩的未来，而这个男孩却在远处的窗户旁玩耍。
一个电话亭和一架钢琴把一间酒吧分割开来。谁拥有这个空间，取决于哪一个平面上依然有动作在发生。
如果只有一个平面承载着故事，这就不是对的工具。三层好看的壁纸算不上层次纵深。
如果你无法想象从近处的物体走到远处的门，那么这幅图式只是一张拼贴画。不要假设每一个纵深的调度都必须整体锐利。
你完全可以同时保留两处动作，并依然做焦点转换。安排本身就是构图，
how: 把有意义的身体或物体放置在彼此分离、且间隙清晰可辨的不同平面上。保持视线和出入口的清晰通畅。
如果想要自然的深空间感，选用更广的镜头并保持更远的距离。如果多个平面都必须锐利，就缩小光圈（并增加光量）。
分裂光圈镜（Split Diopter）是另一种不同的取巧手段。提示词：Three-plane composition around [Subject], foreground, mid, and deep background all carrying information, deep staging.
when: 当两组关系必须在同一个镜头中同时成立时使用它：一笔交易和一个孩子，一支舞和一通电话，一名守卫和一个囚犯。不要把杂物堆叠在三个区域里，就称之为空间调度。
vs: 深焦（Deep Focus）是小光圈和充足光线（或数字模拟）所带来的光学效果。层次纵深即使在选择性对焦的情况下也能存在。
前景兴趣点（Foreground Interest）只保证一个近景层次。层次纵深则要求远处的平面也真正发挥作用。
活人画（Tableau）可以是深或浅的，但它更看重固定的排布而非剪辑。单点透视（One-Point Perspective）可以把这个可行走的空间组织成一条隧道。
examples_film: 《公民凯恩》（Citizen Kane）在室内安排凯恩的未来，而男孩则在窗外玩耍，各平面共处于同一句“语句”之中；《黄金时代》（The Best Years of Our Lives）把一间酒吧分割在钢琴和电话亭之间，迫使注意力必须做出选择。
《同流者》（The Conformist）把法西斯建筑用作一种深邃、可行走的政治空间。这是关于调度的语法，而不是一个焦点预设。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是深焦式的“壁纸”。破绽是所有东西都很锐利，却只有一处动作在发生。
修正方法：在另一个平面上放置第二条故事线，或者承认你想要的其实是单一平面的肖像，然后简化处理。

faq.q: 电影中的层次纵深（Layered Depth）是什么？
faq.a: 重要的动作在同一个构图中占据不同的距离。前景、中景和背景都可以承载信息。这个镜头是“可行走的”。无论每个平面是否都锐利，这种安排本身就是纵深调度。

faq.q: 层次纵深（Layered Depth）与深焦（Deep Focus）有何区别？
faq.a: 层次纵深是空间上的组织：谁站在哪里。深焦是光学上的：多少范围是锐利的。你可以调度三个平面并在其间做焦点转换，也可以缩小光圈让整个舞台都保持清晰。不要把两者混为一谈。

faq.q: 什么时候该用层次纵深（Layered Depth）？
faq.a: 当两种或更多的关系应当无需剪辑就能同时被看见时使用它。如果只有一个平面承担功能，就不要用它。好看的、逐渐远去的墙面并不足够。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写层次纵深（Layered Depth）的提示词？
faq.a: 指明三个平面及其各自的动作。示例：Three-plane composition around [Subject], foreground, mid, and deep background all carrying information, deep staging。说明焦点处理方式。如果你只写“纵深”，可能只会得到模糊而没有调度。

narrative: Social geometry becomes visible at once. Adults sign a boy's future in a near room while the boy plays in a distant window.
A phone booth and a piano split a bar. Who owns space is a matter of which plane can still act.
It is the wrong tool when only one plane has story. Three pretty layers of wallpaper are not layered depth.
If you cannot imagine walking from the near object to the far door, the diagram is a collage. Do not assume every deep stage must be uniformly sharp.
You can hold two actions and still rack. The arrangement is the composition.
how: Place meaningful bodies or objects on separate planes with readable gaps. Keep sightlines and entrances clear.
Choose a wider lens and more distance if you want natural deep space. Stop down (and add light) if several planes must be sharp.
A split diopter is a different cheat. Prompt: Three-plane composition around [Subject], foreground, mid, and deep background all carrying information, deep staging.
when: Use it when two relationships must be true in one hold: a deal and a child, a dance and a call, a guard and a prisoner. Do not stack bric-a-brac in three zones and call it staging.
vs: Deep Focus is the optical result of small aperture and sufficient light, or a digital imitation. Layered depth can exist with selective focus.
Foreground Interest only guarantees a near layer. Layered depth requires the far planes to work.
Tableau may be deep or flat, but it privileges a fixed arrangement over cutting. One-Point Perspective can organize the walkable space as a tunnel.
examples_film: Citizen Kane stages Kane's future indoors while the boy plays outside the window, planes in one sentence. The Best Years of Our Lives splits a bar between piano and telephone booth so attention has to choose.
The Conformist uses fascist architecture as deep, walkable politics. Grammar of staging, not a focus preset.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Deep Focus wallpaper. The tell is everything sharp and only one action.
The fix is to put a second story on another plane, or to admit you wanted a single-plane portrait and simplify.

faq.q: What is layered depth in film?
faq.a: Important actions occupy different distances in one composition. Foreground, midground, and background can all carry information. The shot is walkable. That arrangement is depth staging, whether or not every plane is sharp.

Layered depth is spatial organization: who stands where. Deep focus is optics: how much is sharp. You can stage three planes and rack between them. You can also stop down so the whole stage holds. Do not conflate the two.

faq.q: When should I use layered depth?
faq.a: Use it when two or more relationships should be visible at once without a cut. Skip it when only one plane has a job. Pretty receding walls are not enough.

faq.q: How do I prompt layered depth for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name three planes and their actions. Example: Three-plane composition around [Subject], foreground, mid, and deep background all carrying information, deep staging. State focus treatment. If you only say depth, you may get blur and no staging.
